== Strategy ==

As you can see, it's only rare is C-3P0, so it should be relatively easy to make. I deliberately took out my Obi and my Han's out of this one, because they sort of go against the deck philosophy. But if you have an Obi, by all means, put him in.

Tatooine+Nightfall+Tooex Timer Mine+LIN+Crash Site Memorial Talz - With Nightfall and a 2X he is a combo by himself ;)

How it Works:

Strategy 1. Put down all of your characters as soon as you get them, wait until you have run out of characters in your hand. Start drawing cards until you get a combo. If you put down a few trooper guards, they should be able to hold the fort until you are ready to deploy a combo. Tatooine helps you get the edge in force per turn.

Strategy 2. STOCKPILE! Don't deploy anything. Every turn draw half of what you activated into your hand. In about 10 turns, you should have enough force to put down a combo, get a lot of characters out on the same turn, and start a battle.

1. Talz+Crash Site Memorial practicaly lock the game in your favor. If one of your 2X's gets shot forfeit the Talz in it's place, or just let it go to the Crash Site Memorial! Note: Watch out for Dr. Evazan - He demolishes this deck.

2. If you significantly overpower your enemy try this. Get all of your characters at one site. Move your LIN droid to the site where your opponent has retreated. Deploy a few timer mines, and watch him crack under the dillema (Only works if there are 2 sites down)

3. Put down two Talz's, under nighttime conditions, with a 2X droid. Give one Talz a Tatooine Utility Belt, A Sai'torr Kal Fas, and a Blaster Rifle. You now have a 3-person armada that is power 12, and if your opponent takes pot shots at the boosted Talz, forfeit the other one in it's place. REMEMBER : You can put all weapons, devices, and droids in the Memorial, so don't lose a 2x when you don't have to.

This deck has some weak points, knowing them helps increase the odds when you face them.

1. Dr. Evazan - Self explanatory, opponent kills a 2X, and operates, you are in trouble, end of story.

2. Restraining Bolt + Caller - These simply demolish this deck. Good thing they are not common in decks.

3. Djas Puhr - This annoyance gets power +2 for each dark icon, when under nighttime conditions. Bad news.

4. Wuher - Just when you are buiding up your armada, out comes...Wuher!?! Yup, if your opponent plays with him, shoot him down before he hits the table.

5.Cantina+Wuher OR Djas Puhr OR Laser projector - By itself Cantina is harmless, but with any of the above mentioned cards, you will grow to loathe it.

Hope this has been useful, and I hope I don't have to play against my own deck in a tournament!
